name: Cottage Cheese "Pizza" Bites with Mushrooms, Bell Peppers & Olives (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 6 small food storage containers.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat 12 muffin cups with cooking spray and set aside.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper. Small dice and place in a small bowl (setting aside a small handful for later use).
Drain olives and pat dry with paper towels. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper (setting aside a small handful for later use).
Set aside 12 mushroom slices. Roughly chop remaining mushrooms (they should be the same size as the peppers and olives) and add to the bowl. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (8 oz) pkg sliced white mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs, baking powder, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add chopped veggies, olives, cottage cheese, mozzarella, and flour to the bowl with the egg mixture. Stir until batter is just combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup cottage cheese
½ cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
½ cup bread flour

instructions.primary_message: Divide cottage cheese batter between muffin cups (about ¼-cup per cup), then top each with 1 tablespoon pizza sauce, additional mozzarella, and reserved veggies.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup pizza sauce
½ cup mozzarella cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: Place muffin pan in the oven and bake for 30-35 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely. Once cool, run a butter knife around the edges of each cup, then use the tip of the knife to lift each pizza bite out of the pan.
Divide pizza bites between food storage containers, cover, and refrigerate. Reheat in the oven, air fryer, or microwave if desired. Enjoy!
